source_text: Os iusti meditabitur sapientiam. Non cibis et potu sed meditatione sapientiae vescitur interior homo. Lex aperit os ad verbum Dei.
pass_a_gloss: The mouth of the just will meditate wisdom. Not with foods and drink but by meditation of wisdom the inner man feeds. The law opens the mouth to God’s word.
pass_b_english: [[The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom >> Bible:Psalm 37:30]]. The inner man feeds not on banquets but on meditating wisdom; the law opens the mouth for God’s word.
